codex.harnessHint: Choose the agent harness that runs your tasks.
codex.dotConnectionHint: A verified event round trip is required before assigning work.
codex.readTaskAttachmentsHint: Let Dot read files attached to its current assigned task. File contents are sent to OpenAI. Does not require workspace command access; off by default.
codex.workspaceFilesAndCommandsHint: Let Dot read and write its assigned workspace and publish files. Requires a local Runner. Commands are available only on Linux with bubblewrap; they cannot read your home directory or use injected credentials.
codex.dotUnmeteredHint: Dot does not report token usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a provider spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.
codex.museConnectionHint: Pairing, receiver contact, background reply, and agent setup are verified separately.
codex.museUnmeteredHint: Muse does not report usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a Muse spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.
codex.acpAgentHint: Cursor uses Paperclip questions; per-run cost is unavailable. Pi accepts any provider/model ID. GitHub Copilot awaits qualification.
codex.cursorModeHint: Select Cursor's session mode. Permissions and company approval rules still apply.
codex.unsupportedSavedMode: Unsupported saved mode — select Agent, Plan, or Ask
codex.piThinkingLevelHint: The runner verifies this exact level before each session can prompt. Changing it starts a new session.
